title: Mara
description: Hire Mara. She turns your free users into paying ones with lifecycle emails written in your voice.
longDescription: Mara is an AI email marketing assistant for SaaS products. She reads your website and product, proposes a journey of welcome, activation, win-back, and churn-save emails, and drafts every campaign in your authentic voice — like a human wrote it. Mara segments users from product and payment events, runs A/B tests automatically, sorts and drafts replies, and reports performance weekly in plain language. Integrates with Clerk, Supabase, Stripe, Polar, and webhooks.
